operations.screen: Parts catalogue and homepage preview; support source/branch/assignment selection; public sitemap
operations.source: app/components/parts-catalogue.tsx; app/components/home-catalogue-preview.tsx; app/components/support-source-picker.tsx; lib/api/support-sources.ts; lib/api/sitemap-server.ts; app/sitemap.xml/route.ts; lib/api/public-seed-server.ts; lib/api/public-seed.ts; lib/api/use-resource.ts
operations.implementation: Public discovery plus complete cursor-paged sitemap scan using public IDs only; sitemap fails with 503 on malformed, repeated or incomplete paging, timeout or backend outage. Validated first page is rendered on the server and passed to the interactive list. Metadata/page reads are deduplicated within a request; hydration skips its immediate duplicate fetch. Filters, cursor paging, reconnect/visibility and public account-change events fetch current data. Failed reads hide stale rendered records, and failed initial collection reads are noindex rather than empty.
operations.verification: Production homepage fixtures passed empty and failed requests, populated recovery, server price, detail destination and mobile overflow; complete catalogue filtering and real media verification pending Isolated production SSR/API fixture verified sitemap later-page IDs, no private credentials, configured origin and failure responses; real catalogue scale/concurrent changes remain unverified. Isolated production Edge/API fixtures verify first-page content without JavaScript, private-field stripping before serialization, inert review text, deduplicated initial reads, filter/page/reset, outage recovery, cross-tab refresh and 320/1280px accessibility/layout. Real API/media, production performance and catalogue concurrency remain unverified.

No mutation is automatically replayed; account recovery acknowledges that already-sent work may have completed. Customer quotation projection excludes unpublished drafts, including replaced or voided drafts with no issuedAt. Shared server serialization also applies to mutation and idempotent replay responses. Current request flow optionally loads the authenticated customer's saved vehicles and contact details, retains selected vehicles across cursor pages, submits vehicleId and customerNotes, and renders saved vehicle/notes from the booking response. Booking additionally verifies same-session key/body replay, new-session key replacement, 401 recovery and recovery during a public-read outage. The 19-case public-detail suite passed at 320/1280px; these fixtures do not prove real API ownership or concurrency. September 24 disposable database tests verify owned vehicle acceptance, cross-customer vehicle rejection and no-deposit REQUESTED results with notes. Final production Edge cases passed: paged selection, contact identity checking, partial read failure, anonymous draft preservation, account-change cleanup, uncertain exact-body/key replay and multiline note normalization. operations.implementation: Implemented Cart page pauses edits and checkout after an unknown cart mutation, aborts requests when unmounted and prevents overlapping writes. Original checkout key/body recovery remains available after an uncertain checkout. Customers explicitly select collection or an approved delivery zone and recipient details. Delivery submits the approved zone ID/city/state plus normalized address, never client-calculated fees or totals. Withdrawn zones block delivery; original request and idempotency key survive unknown outcomes. Contact details clear on account changes.
operations.verification: Uncertain checkout fixture reused key/body and made no payment call; stock/price conflict and real transaction tests pending Real loopback browser/API journey passed (local cookies, SSR headings, deposit rounding, cart, checkout and logout as applicable). September 24 disposable PostgreSQL delivery journey passes: fee 10101, taxable base 30101, tax 2258 and total 32359; rejects mismatched city and client fee injection; replay retains original order and reserves inventory once after a policy change. Development Edge completes delivery-to-order totals without initiating payment, but strict console assertion fails on Console Ninja CSP errors. Initial 50-case regression: 41 passed and 9 failed; mobile overflow and ambiguous promotion alert selector fixed; pending payment and staff-order route timeouts passed on rerun. Final development Edge rerun: 16 passed, 6 failed across 22 targeted/regression cases. All 15 delivery cases completed their functional assertions: 13 passed and the customer/owner publication journeys failed only the unchanged strict console assertion. Ten-width overflow and mobile axe checks passed. Five of the six overall failures are injected Console Ninja WebSocket/CSP messages; one is the Next.js development cache header differing from the production no-store assertion. Production browser verification remains pending.

Delivery setup reads owner-only latest-100 delivery versions with areas, fees, approval evidence and scheduled effective times. Bank refund timing supports explicit start event, banking weekdays, approved excluded dates, exact 10-day Lagos counting convention, written approval and effective date. Missing or legacy calendar settings are not invented. Reviewed publication uses expectedVersion and CSRF; unknown/mismatched outcomes lock further writes through history failures, and cancelling an unsent review preserves the draft and keyboard focus. Account changes clear drafts and reviews. COMPLAINTS, DISPUTES and RETENTION now have owner-only forms with reviewed complete settings, source, written approval, effective time, latest-100 history, expectedVersion, exact saved-response validation, persistent uncertain-outcome lock and account cleanup. Contacts use user IDs from paged active/verified directory choices; current detail and active dispute grants are checked separately. Dispute contacts must differ. Retention has 1-20 editable rules, explicit periods/start events/dispositions/legal bases; destructive execution remains disabled. Missing or legacy settings do not invent approved data.

The publication journey passed exact body/CSRF, scheduled Lagos conversion, ten-width overflow and mobile axe, then failed only the unchanged console assertion due to Console Ninja WebSocket/CSP messages. operations.implementation: Integrated: all seven supported policy kinds (BRANCH_CAPACITY, FINANCE, DELIVERY, BANK_REFUND_CLOCK, COMPLAINTS, DISPUTES and RETENTION). Owner chooses an active branch, supplies daily limit/opening days/closed dates and written approval, then reviews before CSRF-protected publication with expectedVersion. Immediate timing is captured at submission; scheduled Lagos dates convert to UTC. Unknown or mismatched outcomes lock changes. Financial policy requires an active FINANCE_POLICY_APPROVE grant, including for Super Admin, invoice details, an explicit delivery VAT choice, written accounting approval, version review and effective date. Interrupted/mismatched results retain their lock through permission-read recovery. Delivery publishes the complete owner-approved area list with exact integer-kobo fees, preserved zone identifiers, written evidence, expectedVersion and immediate/scheduled effectivity. Unknown or mismatched responses lock publication through refresh failures. Bank refund timing supports explicit start event, banking weekdays, approved excluded dates, exact 10-day Lagos counting convention, written approval and effective date. Missing or legacy calendar settings are not invented. Reviewed publication uses expectedVersion and CSRF; unknown/mismatched outcomes lock further writes through history failures, and cancelling an unsent review preserves the draft and keyboard focus. Account changes clear drafts and reviews. COMPLAINTS, DISPUTES and RETENTION now have owner-only forms with reviewed complete settings, source, written approval, effective time, latest-100 history, expectedVersion, exact saved-response validation, persistent uncertain-outcome lock and account cleanup. Contacts use user IDs from paged active/verified directory choices; current detail and active dispute grants are checked separately. Dispute contacts must differ. Retention has 1-20 editable rules, explicit periods/start events/dispositions/legal bases; destructive execution remains disabled. Missing or legacy settings do not invent approved data.
operations.verification: Disposable PostgreSQL verifies owner-only publication, CSRF, approval evidence and stale concurrent approval rejection. Production Edge passed exact branch/version/calendar/evidence payload, scheduled Lagos-to-UTC conversion, validation focus, stale/unknown/mismatched outcome locks. Final production rebuild and 42-case targeted/regression Edge run passed. Finance capability, CSRF, concurrent stale-version rejection and revocation pass in disposable PostgreSQL; Final development Edge run: 19 passed and 3 failed across 22 cases. The three financial publication journeys passed their functional assertions, ten-width overflow and mobile axe where applicable, then failed strict console checks due only to injected Console Ninja WebSocket/CSP errors. Owner read-only, denied/mismatched identities, stale/revoked/interrupted/mismatched writes, lock persistence, validation and account cleanup passed. Clean production browser verification remains pending after automatic review rejected the temporary server launch. Final development Edge rerun: 16 passed, 6 failed across 22 targeted/regression cases. All 15 delivery cases completed their functional assertions: 13 passed and the customer/owner publication journeys failed only the unchanged strict console assertion. Ten-width overflow and mobile axe checks passed. Five of the six overall failures are injected Console Ninja WebSocket/CSP messages; one is the Next.js development cache header differing from the production no-store assertion. Production browser verification remains pending. Bank refund timing: four disposable backend/API/calendar tests passed, including owner/MFA/CSRF boundaries, validation, concurrent version conflict, audit, exact deadline with excluded holiday, future-policy exclusion and preservation of the original snapshot after another approval. Final development Edge run: nine passed, one failed. The publication journey passed exact body/CSRF, scheduled Lagos conversion, ten-width overflow and mobile axe, then failed only the unchanged console assertion due to Console Ninja WebSocket/CSP messages. Validation, no assumed calendar, cancellation focus, stale/interrupted/mismatched results, persistent lock through failed reads, role guards and account cleanup passed. No real policy was approved; clean production browser verification is still pending. Three disposable API/database cases for operational policy kinds passed owner/MFA/CSRF denial, malformed settings, contact verification/status/role/dispute-grant restrictions, stale/concurrent publication, history, audit and unchanged account existence. Initial development Edge run: 21 passed and three failed. Each publication journey completed exact request/CSRF, cancellation focus, scheduled Lagos conversion, history, ten-width overflow and mobile axe before failing only its unchanged strict console check (injected Console Ninja CSP/WebSocket messages; traces inspected with no page exceptions). Other cases passed owner role denial, no invented settings, stale/interrupted/mismatched outcomes, persistent locks, account cleanup, contact ID/grant checks, paging and field validation. Final focused eight-case run: three passed and five failed (three development-console primary checks (Console Ninja, plus an unused Next stylesheet-preload warning on the complaint trace), one delayed development dashboard navigation, one test-label encoding error). After correcting the label, both affected scenarios passed in a two-case rerun. All five additional scenarios therefore passed: customer denial on three routes, multiple retention rules with long history at 320px, and rechecking revoked contact grants. Updated desktop/mobile screenshots were inspected. Production-font and clean production browser verification remain outstanding.

operations.implementation: Branch-authorized staff review a 10?2000-character customer-visible acknowledgement. Fresh preflight checks identity and existing acknowledgement; an already recorded acknowledgement skips the write. One CSRF-protected submission uses the actual message-only contract. Only a matching complaint with a server acknowledgement timestamp confirms the state; the interface does not claim that its message won a concurrent acknowledgement. Account changes abort and discard drafts. The current message page refreshes without remounting a separate reply draft.

The 30-case development support regression completed with 23 passes, six Console Ninja/CSP-only failures and one test locator ambiguity. After narrowing the locator to the saved message, the closed-complaint case passed; three role journeys again reached all functional assertions before only the strict console failure. The unknown-reply lock survived failed and recovered detail reads. Clean production browser verification remains outstanding. No real complaint or outgoing notification was created.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token used to constrain this request.

200.description: Success: Render a read-only attendance confirmation screen.

403.description: Untrusted origin; recovery HTML (global CORS denial may use JSON)

409.description: Invalid, expired, changed or unavailable appointment link; recovery HTML

422.description: Invalid query or form; recovery HTML

429.description: The route-specific request limit was exceeded.

500.description: Result unavailable; recovery HTML without exception details

operations.cache: All browser API requests use no-store. Account-scoped data must be discarded on session change. Refresh the affected resource after a confirmed mutation; never optimistically confirm money or stock.
operations.screen: Signed appointment reminder: /api/v1/public/booking-response (server-rendered HTML through the existing same-origin API rewrite)
operations.implementation: Integrated: status-aware, script-free Quicksand HTML with service, authoritative branch location, Lagos time, explicit attendance form, keyboard-accessible cancellation review, success and safe recovery pages. GET/HEAD remain read-only. Current active verified CUSTOMER, expiring purpose/user/schedule-bound signature and trusted Origin are required; existing cancellation version lock and repeat safety preserved. Malformed input returns 422 HTML. Invalid/expired/stale/restricted links return 409 recovery; server errors advise account review before repeating an uncertain action. No-store/noindex, escaped data, no personal/staff fields, SHA-256 style-only CSP, script-src none and same-origin forms/fonts. strict-origin referrer policy is necessary for native form Origin and never forwards the signed path/query; all navigation links use noreferrer. No browser JSON abstraction or duplicate reminder URL was introduced.
operations.verification: Disposable PostgreSQL: three new API cases plus six existing booking regressions passed (9 total); separate additional database-unavailable mock and validation cases passed (2). Verified GET/HEAD do not write, repeat confirmation/cancellation do not duplicate audit changes, stale/expired/wrong-account links fail, suspended/unverified/promoted accounts fail, CSRF origin denial, 422/413 validation, escaped service strings and omitted customer/staff data. Playwright/Edge: all nine scenarios passed using the actual backend HTML renderer via isolated route interception and the real localhost:3000 font asset, without real booking writes. Native POST sends exact action/token and approved Origin; Referer contains only origin. Eleven widths 320-1920 including landscape, mobile axe, loaded Quicksand, screenshots, no page exceptions/framework overlay and strict clean console passed. API and rendered-HTML browser layers were tested separately; actual emailed link delivery and deployed reverse proxy remain unverified.
